newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV GAINS FURTHER ON HIGHER DOLLAR SUPPLY.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV GAINS FURTHER ON HIGHER DOLLAR SUPPLY.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev rose to 1,510-1,530 per dollar around 1230 local time (0930 GMT) from 1,550-1,560 at midday and 1,570-1,580 at the opening, as dollar supply heavily topped demand, dealers said.
"There are almost no foreign currency bidders in the interbank market. Possibly they are awaiting higher lev levels," one dealer said.
Dollar supply came from both commercial banks and end clients, traders said.
